query: What type of magazine is Eugene Habecker the chairman of?

pipeline_result.response: The correct answer to this question would be "Hachette Filipacchi Media U." The title of the magazine is "Home Magazine," which refers to a publication owned by Hachette Filipacchi Médias.
retrieved_context: Eugene Habecker: Dr. Eugene B. Habecker is the 30th president of Taylor University and chairman of Christianity Today.  Previously, Habecker was president of the American Bible Society.  He is also the author of several books, two coauthored with his wife, Marylou Habecker.  He was inaugurated in a ceremony on Friday, April 28, 2006, in Odle Arena on the Upland campus, only two days after a tragic fatal car accident involving several students and employees.

Hachette Filipacchi Media U.S.: Hachette Filipacchi Media U.S., Inc. (HFM U.S.), originally known as CBS Publications, was a subsidiary of Hachette Filipacchi Médias (one of the world's largest magazine publishers), and was based in New York City.
Home (magazine): Home Magazine was a magazine published in the United States by Hachette Filipacchi Media U.S..
